svg.title: Billing moves from the monolith to its own service
svg.desc: Architecture diagram with 8 components and 8 connections in 1 boundary. Platform: API gateway, Monolith, Billing service, Invoice events, Accounts. Most connected: Billing service (4 connections). Nothing leads into Customer. Nothing leads out of Invoice events, Accounts and Payment provider. Bottleneck: API gateway; without it the diagram falls apart. Customer (person): connects to Customer portal (pays). Customer portal (frontend): connects to API gateway (calls, via HTTPS). API gateway (security): connects to Monolith (routes today) and Billing service (routes after). Monolith (service): connects to Accounts (via SQL). Billing service (service): connects to Accounts (via SQL), Invoice events (publishes) and Payment provider (charges, via HTTPS). Accounts (database): no outgoing connection. Invoice events (queue): no outgoing connection. Payment provider (external system): no outgoing connection. Roles: critical: API gateway, Accounts, Billing service → Payment provider; planned: Billing service, Invoice events, API gateway → Billing service, Billing service → Accounts, Billing service → Invoice events; deprecated: Monolith, API gateway → Monolith, Monolith → Accounts.
